Name: Mining Monthly Beginner Kit
Author: dfs168
Description:
[b]Why you might want this mod for early game?
[/b]
Do you find swiping at monsters a thousand times with the Rusty Sword to be tedious?
Do want a decent weapon from the start that will last you through much of the mines?
Do you want a good pair of boots to give you a decent amount of defense and immunity?
Do you forget to pack your torches when going to the mines and wish for a magnet and glow ring?
Do you want to be just a bit more efficient at breaking rocks with your sad entry-level pickaxe?
Do you often find yourself in the mines way too late to walk home and don't want to pass out in the mines?

[b]The backstory[/b]

You get your hands on the latest Mining Monthly before you move to Stardew Valley. An article catches your attention, it reads:

[quote]﻿ Enter into the Mining Monthly Beginner Kit Competition to win a fantastic beginner kit containing:

[list=1]
[*]A Neptune's Glaive weapon
[*]A pair of Dark Boots
[*]A Glowstone Ring
[*]10 Miner's Treats
[*]5 Farm Warp Totems
[/list]
All you need to do is enter online at Mining Monthly with the code #IAMAWINNER and we will notify winners by mail on Spring 1 Yr1.[/quote]

[b]And it turns out you WON![/b]

You already entered and won the competition! You will automatically receive a mail containing the listed items on Day 1.

[b]Is it over-powered?[/b]

This kit aims to help ease your start in the mines and make the early grind a bit more enjoyable.

The weapon and the boots are both available day 1 from fishing treasure chests. The Magnet ring and the Glow ring are also available in fishing chests but it's a bit more convenient to have the single Glowstone ring. It is possible to get a Glowstone ring early game at the Stardew Valley Fair. Farm Warp Totems are available early game and Miner's Treats are craftable at level 3 mining.

So while the items in the kit do give you a very good boost (and might be considered a little bit cheaty), the kit is still reasonably well-balanced and just improves the early game mining/combat experience if you find it a bit tedious or don't like mining/combat. You will likely replace the non-consumable items as you progress through the mines and level up in mining and combat.  Selling the items would not give too much gold.
[b]
How does it work?[/b]

This mod uses the Mail Framework Mod to deliver a message to your mailbox on Day 1 containing the listed items as attachments. You can wear the boots and the ring immediately and store the other 3 items until the mines are open.
